title: Production Issues & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
subtitle: Emergency Incident War Room & Root Cause Analysis
description: An automated alert flashes red on Martha's monitoring dashboard: A minor memory leak in the Attendance Sync microservice caused intermittent 504 gateway timeouts for 12 branch officers. Decide the remediation strategy, restore the service, prepare the formal RCA, and prioritise preventive controls.

stakeholders.name: Jane
stakeholders.agenda: Leading response: Mandating formal RCA, verifying recovery before closing, and updating monitoring.

stakeholders.name: Martha
stakeholders.agenda: Automated incident detection, user impact tracking, and updating monitoring alert thresholds.

stakeholders.name: Alex
stakeholders.agenda: Drafting hotfix patch for the memory leak in Attendance Sync and deploying under Jane's engineering governance.

objectives.label: Decide remediation strategy: Mandate formal RCA alongside hotfix deployment
Arrange immediate service restoration sequence & verify branch officers
Build and publish formal 4-part Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
Select and prioritise recurrence prevention controls and alert thresholds
